CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)

   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

5. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

10. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain String Musical Instruments and Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Collage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
